subject: E-Commerce
title: Headless Commerce Architecture
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Headless Commerce Architecture.

hook.text: Headless commerce separates the storefront from the backend. Sell through any screen: watches, cars, fridges, or VR.

buildup.text: Traditional e-commerce ties the website design to the shopping system. Headless decouples them completely.

discovery.text: With headless, a brand can power purchases on websites, apps, smart TVs, and even smart mirrors—all from one backend.

twist.text: Headless commerce requires more technical expertise. Small businesses can't afford the engineering headless demands.

climax.text: Headless architecture enables commerce everywhere any screen exists. The store is no longer a place—it's a capability.

punchline.text: Any screen is a store. Headless commerce untethers shopping from websites.

quiz.question: What does 'headless commerce' mean?
options: The storefront display is separated from the commerce backend, enabling sales on any screen
